name: DS9 Debate School Nine
original_name: DS9 ディベートスクールナイン
source:
As a part of class studies home teacher chose 9th Amendment to the constitution as a debate topic. The classroom is going to become the battlefield between supporters of 9th Amendment and revisionists. Naoki did not have particular interest for the agenda and kept neutral position.

"Please stand up with the Guardians !!"
"Please enter the constitutional reform faction !!" 

Bribe? Intimidation? Venus trap? All means are good to bring Naoki to one's camp. 

Shall Naoki give in to pressure or be able to find his own answer on the matter?

[Translated and edited from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=824138]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
作为课堂学习的一部分，家庭教师选择宪法第九修正案作为辩论主题。课堂将成为第九修正案支持者和修正主义者之间的战场。直树对议程没有特别的兴趣，保持中立立场。

“请与守护者一起站起来！！”
“请进入修宪派！！” 

贿赂？恐吓？金星陷阱？想尽办法把直树带到自己的营地。

直树是应该屈服于压力，还是能够找到自己的答案？

[翻译和编辑自 [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=824138]Getchu[/url]]
